name: bank_statement_imports
title: Statement Imports
description: One row per import run -- the provenance record every bank line points at. Append-only: an import is a historical event, not a document to edit. status is computed by the gates, never chosen by the importer: accepted when every check that COULD run passed, flagged when arithmetic disagrees with the file. flags records which checks RAN as well as which passed, because a balance-less CSV that passed nothing must not read as trustworthy as a tied-out statement (see object_banking.run_gates). Lines from a flagged import still land -- evidence is evidence -- but the reconciliation view marks them lower-assurance rather than hiding the problem.

fields.name: file_hash
fields.label: File Hash
fields.help: sha256 of the statement file. Re-importing the same file is a no-op -- the same idempotency-by-provenance posture composed journals get from generated_from.

fields.name: status
fields.label: Status
fields.help: Set by the gates, not by hand: flagged means tie-out or continuity failed (truncated file, missing period, edited export).
